content.name: Fence

default_owner: app_owner

grants:
  - role: orders_reader
    privileges: [SELECT]
    object: { type: table, schema: app, name: "*" }

default_privileges:
  - owner: app_owner
    scope: { type: schema, schema: app }
    grant:
      - role: orders_reader
        privileges: [SELECT]
        on_type: table
